title: File:Site entrance to housing estate (geograph 6437511).jpg
author: M J Roscoe
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 2.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), imported from geograph.org.uk (image 6437511). Commons description: Site entrance to housing estate. Gated entrance to new estate. Daylight shot: after searching Commons and Openverse in English, German, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Dutch, French and Finnish, no sharp modern dusk or night photo of a large site with an open gate or a person inside the fence was found (the night candidates either showed a closed gate or nobody). Chosen because both gate leaves stand wide open onto the site road with no one at the entrance. No identifiable people (one tiny worker on the scaffold at the far left edge). Lettering on a skip blurred.

title: File:Deeper and bigger trenches - geograph.org.uk - 7697617.jpg
author: Neil Owen
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 2.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), imported from Geograph Britain and Ireland (image 7697617). Seen through the mesh site fence: a man in a dark hooded top, without helmet or high-visibility clothing, stands at the lip of a deep open excavation with no edge protection while workers in high-visibility clothing work in the trench below. The standing man is seen from behind. The face of the worker in the trench and the brand lettering on brick packs at the top were blurred.

title: File:Neubau AK-Bezirksstelle Kirchdorf 1.jpg
author: Christoph Waghubinger (Lewenstein)
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 4.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. Commons description: Kirchdorf an der Krems, view from the Sengsschmiedstrasse into the excavation of the new Chamber of Labour building. Seen through the site fence: a man in a red T-shirt and shorts stands without helmet or vest beside the concrete mixer truck at the rim of the sheet piled pit, while a worker in a yellow helmet works in the pit below. Only a tight crop of the 3840 px download is used (1190 px wide after processing). His face, the face of the worker in the pit, the truck number plate, a contractor banner with passers-by beyond the fence, a sign and the mixer brand lettering were blurred.
